Recognize the approach

Playful describes an intended tone rather than one historical movement.

Look for

  • Friendly scale changes
  • Loose illustrative forms
  • Small surprises within stable navigation

Your learning goal

Describe the visual decisions before choosing a tool. Then make one small example that uses them deliberately.

Next: Origins

Where it comes from

Playful describes an intended tone rather than one historical movement. Rounded forms, irregular illustration, and unexpected color can support it, but their use should fit the subject and audience.

Period or influence
Ongoing; no single founding date

What to examine

Look at the heading, one control, the image treatment, and the reading order. Explain which decisions establish the style and which make the page usable.

Next: Construction

How to construct it

  1. Create one original illustrated motif and repeat its line and corner treatment.
  2. Use motion only for specific feedback. Keep forms, labels, and reading order predictable.

Small practice task

Give one ordinary form a playful heading and illustration without changing the field labels or their order.

Before you expand it

Test the result at its intended size, on a narrow screen, and with keyboard focus. Preserve editable layers and record the source and license of acquired assets.
